tasks.task: Write a shot list for a product shoot

items.when: Before the list, to decide which eight images the product page needs and what is missing
When the channels are known and you need every shot, angle, crop and prop written down
When the seller needs a quick list for one product, with the reason for each shot
When you are unsure what to show, to list the questions shoppers ask that a photo can answer

tasks.task: Write a creative brief for a hired photographer

items.when: When the seller cannot describe the look, to pin down tone and feel in four answers
When the style is open, to compare photo styles and pick one main, one to test, one to avoid
When the photographer must quote and shoot from one document with every shot listed
When the shoot is for a campaign and the brief must carry the brand and the goal
When one shoot must cover both stills and video and each shot needs a reason

tasks.task: Write a brand photo style guide

items.when: When the seller shares photos they like, to turn them into light, colour and feel you can name
When the look is undecided, to compare three mood board directions with photo rules
When a direction is picked and you need background, light, crop and edit rules for every photo
When every frame is crowded with props and the product gets lost
When sample photos follow the guide, to find each fault and see if the set holds together

tasks.task: Set up a home or phone studio

items.when: When photos shot at home look grey, yellow, dark or change from one day to the next
When the set-up works and you want the same light and edit steps written down for next time
When the light is flat, to decide what the photo should show and where light and dark must fall

tasks.task: Write an edit recipe for Lightroom or Snapseed

items.when: When every photo needs the same true-to-life edit, step by step, in the seller's own app
When the edited set is done, to list each fault with one fix and a score

tasks.task: Write an image size and file spec for each sales channel

items.when: When images go to Amazon, Shopify, Google or Etsy and each needs its size, ratio and background
When files are exported, to see what to resize or rename before they go live
When Google has flagged products, to see which image problems cost the most sales

tasks.task: Audit the images on a listing or product page

items.when: Before the audit, to see which products get returns that point to misleading photos
When a product sells less than it should or buyers keep asking the same questions
When you have the images and the plan, to get every fault, one fix each and a score
When reviews and questions show doubts, to review the gallery and plan images that answer them
When the store is large, to find products and variants with no image or too few

tasks.task: Plan the full image set for a product page

items.when: When nobody knows why shoppers hesitate, to collect their doubts before planning images
When you have photos and facts and need an eight-image plan with a gaps list
When the seller wants a fast plan for the eight pictures from what they already have
When real photos exist and each gallery image should answer one shopper question
When the images are fine one by one but the set tells no story in order
When the set is made, to score it against the plan and list the fixes

tasks.task: Plan Amazon main and secondary images

items.when: Before the shoot, to set Amazon's white background, fill, size and file rules
When a secondary image must show size, parts or benefits with labels
When the image is seen as a small thumbnail, to score what reads in three seconds

tasks.task: Change a background or scene with an AI tool

items.when: Before any AI edit, to write down what the real product looks like so it cannot drift
Before using an AI editor, to say what may change and what must stay exactly as shot
When the seller has a photo they like, to get ranked pictures in that style
When you must extend or clean up a real photo the seller already owns
Before upload, to check the edited image against each channel's rules on AI images

tasks.task: Make a matching AI photo set from real product photos

items.when: Before making images, to get a style sheet and nine matching photo prompts
When the seller wants to see the product in three different looks before choosing
When phone photos are all there is and you need 8 to 12 images, each with a job
When the set must be checked frame by frame and every failed frame redone
When you edit or combine real photos with plain requests and need the product kept
When the seller sends feedback, to turn each fix into a rule for every later image

tasks.task: Prepare clothing and accessory photos

items.when: When you have a phone photo of a garment and need clean, worn-shape and close-up shots
When images show people, to check they look real and are shown fairly

tasks.task: Keep photos matching across a large catalogue

items.when: Before a batch, to fix the one look every product photo must share
When a sheet of products needs one matching photo each, with a faults report
After the batch, to find any product or variant still short of images

tasks.task: Refresh catalogue images when channel rules change

items.when: Each quarter, or when a channel changes its image rules, to find and fix what fails
When a rule has changed, to rewrite the spec sheet before anyone re-exports files
When you have the current files, to list what to resize and rename
When an old photo is too small for a new rule and cannot be reshot

tasks.task: Run a new range shoot from brief to live images

items.when: When a new range needs a full image set for every channel, shot at home or by a hired photographer
When the range is fixed and you need one list that covers every product in one day
Before the shoot, to agree the image set each product page will carry
When the shots are back, to check each product's set before it goes live

tasks.task: Plan the shoot day schedule and prep list

items.when: When you need the shots grouped by set-up so the day runs in the fewest changes
When the day is part of a launch and you need the steps before and after it in order
When stills and video are shot on the same day and must share set-ups

tasks.task: Get and compare photographer quotes

items.when: When hiring a photographer, to get like-for-like quotes and settle ownership first
When the photographer asks what the shoot is for before they can price it
When the photographer sends terms, to flag who owns the images and where they may be used

tasks.task: Brief a short product demo, unboxing or how-to video

items.when: When a listing or post needs a short video and someone must film it from a plan
When it is unclear what kind of video fits, to pick the tool, script and shot plan
When a phone-filmed creator look may beat a studio look, to get a script and filming brief
When the script is agreed and you need timed shots and an edit list
When there is no footage, to turn product photos into a short reel with captions that fit
When clips are filmed, to check they cover the script and plan the cut and captions

tasks.task: Make lifestyle and social images from product photos

items.when: Before any new scene, to lock the product details every image must keep
When the brand wants a candid snapshot feel from one real occasion
When the image is for an ad and the real product must stay exact
When the image is pretty but says nothing, to join one picture to one line
Before posting, to get a pass or fail on each image and one fix where the product no longer matches

tasks.task: Test which main image wins the click

items.when: Before the test, to see if the listing has enough visits and how many weeks it needs
Before spending traffic, to drop versions that do not read at thumbnail size
When results are in, to check the split and call a winner with a confidence range

tasks.task: Prepare final files: names, alt text, size and speed

items.when: When you need the file names and alt text pattern each channel expects
When a Shopify store's images have no alt text and it should be set on each
When files are too heavy and must load faster without looking worse
When the seller edits photos inside Shopify and you must know what it can do
Before handover, to check sizes, names and alt text and get a score

always.when: Before any work that must match the seller's live store: colours, mood and voice
When an image carries a size, number or claim you cannot trace to the seller

helpers.when: When the job is a full product video with a script, crew and edit, not a short brief
When images need text, labels or layouts such as infographics, banners or ads
When the images are part of a whole Amazon listing with title, bullets and A+ content
When the image work needs theme changes, bulk uploads or page speed fixes
When the gallery needs captions, on-image words or a product description to match
When the pack itself reads badly in photos and needs a redesign, not a reshoot

gaps: No library item covers real lighting set-ups, camera or phone settings, or white balance for a home studio; only the kit prompt does
No library item writes an edit recipe for Lightroom, Snapseed or similar apps, or checks colour against the real product
No library item builds a shoot day schedule, call sheet or prep and props list
No library item covers model or property releases, image usage licences, or comparing photographer quotes like for like
No library item plans an Amazon image set: main image rules, secondary infographic images and A+ image modules
No library item gives image rules for Etsy, Google Merchant Center or TikTok Shop one by one; one general rule checker covers all
No library item covers hard-to-shoot products such as food, jewellery, glass and other shiny items
No library item specs a 360 spin or sets listing video sizes and lengths per channel
No library item checks where retouching crosses the line into a misleading photo, or when an AI image must be labelled
No English library item checks photos against marketplace image rules, plans main image test versions or keeps one style file for a catalogue; those that exist are written in Chinese
No English library item makes try-on, ghost mannequin, fabric close-up, background-swap or retouched photos on its own; those that exist are written in Chinese
